messages.en: Waaahhh.
I just ate nakgopsae and I'm about to pass out.
I ordered delivery just for myself.
Yesterday, on my birthday,
I did a live,
ShiOn unnie treated me to a meal and a movie.
We watched Spider-Man,
and it was so much fun,
though it was two hours long, so I almost fell asleep halfway through.
I barely managed to keep my eyes open and finished it. ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ
As soon as I got back to the hotel, I completely passed out.
Still, for the rest of my birthday,
ShiOn unnie
really wanted me to enjoy it,
so I was really thankful. ㅠㅠ
And everyone who wished me a happy birthday right at midnight...
I saw every single one of you~
It really touched me~ ❤️❤️
Wow, I just lay down,
and I almost threw everything back up.
That's why you shouldn't lie down right after eating...

messages.ko: 그리고 요즘 새로 생긴 내 취미
messages.en: And let me tell you about my new hobby.
Here it is.

messages.ko: 배달을 시킬때 무조건 김치추가 해서 한통 더 산다음에
messages.en: Whenever I order delivery, I always add an extra container of kimchi,
and I've been collecting them in my fridge.
So I've got the green onion kimchi that came with my jjajangmyeon,
the fresh kimchi that came with my kalguksu,

messages.ko: 또 뭐였지 암튼 푹익은 김치 하나랑
messages.en: what else... anyway, some well-fermented kimchi,
and stir-fried kimchi.
I've got them all.
Personally,
I like kimchi that's really fermented and soft,

messages.ko: 그 시중에서 파는 맛 인위적인 단맛의 김치
messages.en: or the store-bought kind with that artificial sweetness.
Those are the kinds I like.
Wait, have I ever told you about my three-egg ramen?
Did I?
If you ever go to a PC café,
order Ansungtangmyun with three eggs and stir-fried kimchi.
Give it a try.
It's seriously delicious.
With three eggs, isn't it basically steamed eggs?
That's exactly what it tastes like.

messages.ko: 이게 계란찜인가 계란탕인가 싶다가 아 라면이다! 싶은 그 맛
messages.en: You start wondering, 'Is this steamed eggs? Egg soup?' and then go, 'Oh right, it's ramen!' That's the kind of taste.
If you order it like this, you won't leave a drop of the broth.
Because there are eggs all throughout the broth.
It's such a lovely flavor.
Also, my Bastion is level 20 now.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋ
That's pretty fast considering it's a new account.
I usually get around 26 eliminations.
10,000 damage is basically my baseline.
Don't underestimate Ha-stion~
But they added a new character named Shion.
ShiOn unnie~?
She has white hair, rides a motorcycle, and she's seriously pretty.
I think she's the prettiest Overwatch character.
I'm practicing with her now.
I'm planning to make her my second main.
I really want to end up on the enemy team against you!!

messages.ko: 나 한번도 못죽이고 계속 죽어봐야 이런소리 안하지~
messages.en: You won't be saying that after I keep taking you out while you can't eliminate me even once~
What do you think Bastion's biggest charm is, HaYeon?
He's cute.

messages.ko: 못알아듣는 말 혼자 삐빅삐빅하다가 지혼자 웃는것도 귀엽고
messages.en: It's adorable how he just goes 'beep beep' in his own language and laughs to himself.
ㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋㄹㄹㅋ
Please film a Signal of yourself gaming at a PC café. ㅜㅜ
Should I film a PC café vlog?
If it gets approved,
I'll film and upload it.
Did today's Signal get uploaded?
Ooh.
When did they even film that?
That's such a cute piece of content.
Also,

messages.ko: 라이브에서 정하연 사랑해 쫙 올라오는거 보니
messages.en: seeing the chat fill up with 'Jeong HaYeon, I love you' during the live
made me feel so happy.
Do it one more time~~
ㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
What's with that dry little 'I love you~'..? 🥲💓
It wasn't dry.
It's just a little embarrassing to say it out loud. ㅎ

messages.ko: 하연아 너 데이트 2편에서 채연 혜린이랑 삼각관계 데이트 해야함
messages.en: HaYeon, in Dating Part 2, you need to go on a love triangle date with ChaeYeon and HyeRin.
Huh?
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ
Whoever gets to go on a date with me~
would be lucky. ㅋ
So when are we doing a dating show with all 24 members?
I want to receive all 23 girls' votes already~
Although I've already decided on my final choice. ㅎㅎ
It's Y/n.
Ah, no, that won't work~
If I keep getting picked for dates,
I'd be exhausted~~
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㄹㅋ
You're sleepy because you ate nakgopsae, aren't you?
Huh? This wasn't a dream?
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹ Don't get too jealous~~
I'll just talk to them one by one,
then I'll come back to Y/n~
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋ
Would HaYeon still be the villain even on a dating show?
The villain is always the most charming one.

messages.ko: 그럼 하연이 슈퍼배드에서 그루 같은 느낌인건가
messages.en: So does that make you like Gru from Despicable Me?
My neck isn't *that* forward, though.
Speaking of which,

messages.ko: 우리 허리를 피고 목을 뒤로 스트레칭 한번 하자
messages.en: let's all straighten our backs and stretch our necks backward.

messages.ko: 평소에 굽어있던게 펴지면 2cm까지 클 수 있데
messages.en: They say if you straighten a posture that's usually hunched over, you can gain up to 2 cm.
Then I'd be 170 cm~
But even I think
I don't have the face of someone who's tall.
Judging by just your face, you look like you'd be 17 cm tall.
What am I, Thumbelina? ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ
Oh right, I started a load of laundry.
Hang on.
Okay, I started the dryer too.
Now I feel at ease.
Why am I sweating so much just from doing that one thing?
Stamina issue.
They say you sweat more when your body's heavier...
So what!!!!

messages.ko: 아진짜 누가 우리 돼지 자꾸 놀림?? 하 내가혼내줄게
messages.en: Seriously, who's been teasing our little pig?? I'll go teach them a lesson.
Pig...? What did you just say?
Fine...
This little pig is going to watch Hello Jadoo and head to bed.

messages.ko: 나 안녕자두야 초딩 때 이후로 본 적이 없어 …
messages.en: I haven't watched Hello Jadoo since elementary school...
I cried watching the 'Mom's True Feelings' episode of Hello Jadoo.
It's a masterpiece.
Everyone, go watch Hello Jadoo,
and good night.
Haranghae~ 😘😘
